summary: Delivery audit of the whole Kiln Build Preflight PRD at 7cdd55e: all 10 criteria in force (AC-PREFLIGHT-01, -02, -03, -05, -06, -08 and AC-ATTEND-01, -03, -04, -05) are implemented and reachable from their entry points; AC-PREFLIGHT-04, AC-PREFLIGHT-07 and AC-ATTEND-02 were retired before the build. One round of fresh assessors found no gap, so no completion phase was added and the test audit comes next.
